terra.problem: Saying this is a tough way to start a day adds a time of day the passage does not give.
Saying there was no feast or plate of cookies asserts details the passage does not give.
The passage does not say nobody lined up or carried anyone out, or that the messengers walked back out with arrangements in their hands.
“I'm not going to joke about it” comments on how Papa Dorin is telling the passage.
Saying he will keep his jokes in the oven comments on how he is telling the passage.
The rain joke makes light of the proposed destruction of the villagers. The closing line also comments on how Papa Dorin is telling the passage.
“I won't make up a speech for Him” comments on how Papa Dorin is telling the passage.
The text does not say they packed up or explicitly give the refusal as the reason they went to another village.
The passage does not say whether they unpacked.
Papa Dorin says he would be walking out, but he remains on his gold base and cannot step off it.
The explanation mostly repeats the question and answer without adding a meaningful explanation or a clear touch of Papa Dorin's personality.
“I won't guess at more than the verse gives us” comments on how Papa Dorin is telling the passage.
The oven joke does not make a clear comparison to looking back while plowing. The cookies having plans of their own is an unclear punchline.
